description: Sends a test message ("<channel name> Testing") through a saved notification channel, as the Test button in Uptime Kuma does, to check its settings work. It really is delivered, to Slack, email or wherever the channel points, so do not repeat it without reason. Nothing is saved. Find the ID with listNotifications.
